title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: GWEN'S PROMOTION
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Gwen Talbot, a forklift driver at a cheese warehouse in Burlington, Vermont.
For nine years, Gwen trained every new hire on that floor.
Then the shift lead job went to Kyle. A guy she trained last spring.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE BREAK ROOM
segments.author: Chinese proverb
lines: For two weeks, Gwen complained in the break room. Even to the vending machine.
Her friend Rosa finally put down her sandwich and said an old Chinese proverb:
Talk doesn't cook rice.
Then Rosa asked, Did you ever actually ask for that job?
Gwen had not. So she booked a meeting with the plant manager, Mr. Doyle.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE NUMBERS
segments.quote: In the fields of observation chance favors only the prepared mind.
segments.author: Louis Pasteur
lines: Her dad told her to go in ready, and quoted Louis Pasteur, the French scientist:
In the fields of observation chance favors only the prepared mind.
So Gwen dug out her numbers.
Thirty one people trained. Nine years. Zero accidents. One very famous wheel of cheddar, saved.
She put it all in a big blue binder.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE MIRROR
segments.quote: Self-trust is the first secret of success.
segments.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
lines: The night before, her stomach did backflips. Who was she to ask?
Taped on her fridge was a line from Ralph Waldo Emerson:
Self-trust is the first secret of success.
So she practiced her pitch in the bathroom mirror. Then on her cat.
The cat was not impressed. Gwen went anyway.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE BIG BINDER
segments.quote: Speak softly and carry a big stick; you will go far.
segments.author: Theodore Roosevelt
lines: Walking in, she wanted to yell, I deserved that job!
Then she thought of the Teddy Roosevelt poster in Mr. Doyle's office:
Speak softly and carry a big stick; you will go far.
Her big stick was the binder. She spoke softly and let the numbers shout.
Mr. Doyle read every page, then sighed. No money this year.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE DEAL
segments.quote: Let us never negotiate out of fear. But let us never fear to negotiate.
segments.author: John F. Kennedy
lines: Gwen almost said, Okay, sorry, and ran. Then she remembered President Kennedy:
Let us never negotiate out of fear. But let us never fear to negotiate.
So she asked, What would it take?
Run the messy night shift for ninety days. If it works, it's yours. With a raise.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE NIGHT CREW
segments.quote: The deepest principle of human nature is the craving to be appreciated.
segments.author: William James
lines: The night crew was grumpy and late. Gwen knew how it felt to be overlooked.
Her dad sent her a line from William James, the American thinker:
The deepest principle of human nature is the craving to be appreciated.
So she learned every name and thanked people out loud for good work.
In ninety days, it was the best shift in the building. Gwen got the job. Now Kyle asks her for advice.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Ask. Prepare. Trust yourself. Speak softly. Negotiate. Say thank you.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Ask for it. Come prepared. Trust yourself. Speak softly. Don't fear the deal. And say thank you.
I once asked for a raise. They gave me a bigger chair.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
